claims.text: The Legislative Assembly's article of 11 May 2020 states that Siaosi Pohiva won the Tongatapu 1 by-election in November of the previous year, 16 votes ahead of his opponent, printed as Dr. Netatua Prescott, and that he replaces his late father, former Prime Minister 'Akilisi Pohiva.
claims.uncertainty: Month precision as printed. The 28 November date in the 19 November 2019 notice is not substituted for it, because that notice predates the poll. The opponent's name differs from that notice (Dr. Netatua Pelesikoti Taufatofua); the variants are not reconciled. No Electoral Commission result record was seen.

claims.text: The same article reports that Siaosi Pohiva has been sworn in as People's Representative for Tongatapu 1, taking his oath to abide by the Constitution and the law of Tonga.
claims.locator: Article title and body, paragraph 1; created date in the article details
claims.uncertainty: The article date is the attestation: he had been sworn in by 11 May 2020, but the oath day is not given. A seat oath is not a party office.
